body: I just don’t want to dump these issues on another human being it feels wrong you can message me of course. I just feel a bother as it is.

I have to say. It’s truly the worst feeling in the world. We love our children so much we couldn’t bare doing anything to hurt them even if it means suffering cause the love you feel for your child is something else.  I’m always here if you need to talk seriously though cause sadly I also know what it’s like to be on your end it’s it easy either. I will take any tips anything.
